source_record.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
source_record.description:
About the Role

Join the technical pre-sales team at a Series A R&D software company serving science-driven organizations. You will help customers modernize research and development workflows by connecting their data and technical needs to practical platform solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Own technical pre-sales engagements from initial demonstrations through value case development, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots for prospect R&D workflows.

  • Partner with sales colleagues and customer stakeholders to communicate value and support new business.

  • Lead technical evaluations and present how digital tools can improve R&D data management and innovation.

  • Mentor new graduate team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write scripts and configure integrations to support prospect requirements.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for customer meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of relevant experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or R&D leadership.

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, or a related field, ideally with a computational or machine learning focus.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and experience with R&D workflows and laboratory informatics.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, including integrations or orchestration.

  • Experience in technical pre-sales, consulting, or R&D leadership in a large chemical or materials organization.

  • Python scripting ability, strong communication skills, and willingness to travel.

  • Fluent English; EU-based candidates should have C1 or higher proficiency in a local language.

  • Work authorization in the United States, United Kingdom, or Germany.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $120,000 to $150,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Remote, with Munich, Bavaria, Germany as the primary location.
